result.summary: The application interface appears mostly consistent, but there is a notable layout issue regarding the clipping of restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is cut off by the right edge of the screen, even though it is not part of a horizontally scrollable list that justifies truncation.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or font size of the restaurant cards, or wrap the text to ensure the full name is displayed.
